slides.title: PROBLEM STATEMENT AND PROJECT OBJECTIVE
slides.notes: Explain the three operational handoffs and the objective without invented market or revenue figures.

shapes.text: TEAMFARE  |  VULTR AGENT RUSH  |  POWERING THE FUTURE OF WORK
A team outing combines employee engagement with operational work. Decisions often move between messages, calendars and spreadsheets.
Organisers compare venues, collect availability and follow up on attendance through separate conversations.
Managers need the estimated total, allowance and approval history before a team proceeds.
Receipts and spending entries must be collected and consolidated into a report.
Provide a shared workflow that carries an outing from researched options through scheduling, manager review, attendance and expense reporting.

slides.notes: The example contains two actual replies from the shared demonstration accounts. Calendar export is not external calendar synchronisation.

Availability is based on explicit teammate replies. Unanswered invitations remain visible instead of being treated as agreement.
Saved activity interests help organisers select the guest list.

A separate manager reviews the proposal before approval. The review exposes timing, headcount, estimated cost and the remaining allowance.

Over-budget approval and stale revisions are rejected. Activity records the actual actor.

slides.title: EXPENSE RECORDING AND REPORTING
slides.notes: A receipt is private evidence attached to an expense. No payment, booking or reimbursement is initiated. Public judge outbound email is disabled.

Recorded spending and its supporting files remain attached to the approved outing, ready for the manager’s report.
PDF, PNG and JPEG uploads have size limits. Access is restricted to the expense creator, payer and managers.

A private-team manager can email the filtered report to a verified teammate. Real delivery was tested separately.

slides.title: SECURITY AND OPERATIONAL RELIABILITY
slides.notes: These are implemented boundaries, not a claim that every possible vulnerability has been excluded. The research agent does not execute arbitrary model-generated code.

shapes.text: TEAMFARE  |  VULTR AGENT RUSH  |  POWERING THE FUTURE OF WORK
The model researches options; authenticated product rules control the decisions, records and external messages.
Normal accounts verify email ownership and use password-plus-code sign-in. Origin, CSRF and team-scope checks protect requests.
Search, source reading and option submission have time, call and usage limits. Source IDs and price claims are validated.
Revision checks reject stale writes. Transactions and encrypted durable email jobs support retries and duplicate protection.
Encrypted off-VM backups include receipt bytes. Downloads, decryption, integrity and restore checks have been exercised.
Public judge accounts are deliberately isolated and restricted; ordinary accounts retain email verification.

slides.notes: All numbers describe actual test runs already recorded in the repository. The read workload is a small-team measurement, not an enterprise-scale capacity test.

Verification combines automated checks with real deployed accounts, providers, restart persistence and offsite recovery.
Authentication, permissions, revisions, receipts, outbox retries, calendar/CSV serialization and backups.
12 preview journeys, 4 account/workflow journeys and 1 fixture-backed research journey.
Actual email proofs, research, scheduling, review, RSVP, private receipts and reporting.
16 requests in flight across 4 users. Median 176 ms; p95 527 ms in one measured run.
Sessions, RSVP, receipt bytes and 8 reminders persisted. Cancellation stopped all 8.
Encrypted objects restored on the developer’s PC; receipt hashes and original accounts matched.
Scope: controlled technical checks and a small-team read test; no claim of zero bugs or general capacity.

slides.notes: Invite the judges to try both roles. Public credentials are intentional demonstration accounts, not real inboxes. The reference academic deck was used only for presentation style.

shapes.text: TEAMFARE  |  VULTR AGENT RUSH  |  POWERING THE FUTURE OF WORK
Teamfare delivers a working research → scheduling → approval → attendance → expense-reporting workflow. Employees organise time together while managers retain a clear spending record.
Vultr runs the web application, backend, model inference and encrypted backup storage. Venue bookings and payments remain external; calendar files are exports.
